changeSet.comment: Seed `layers` on SE_RIS_VISIT so RIS-study uploads spawn both fluid + layers. Idempotent — skips if either the event_definition is missing or the row already exists.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO event_definition_retinal_task (study_event_definition_id, task, created_by_user_id) SELECT sed.study_event_definition_id, 'layers', NULL FROM study_event_definition sed WHERE sed.oc_oid = 'SE_RIS_VISIT' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_definition_retinal_task t WHERE t.study_event_definition_id = sed.study_event_definition_id AND t.task = 'layers' );
